content: @inquirer/prompts (npm registry verified v8.5.2, 29.4M weekly downloads) is the modern modular rewrite of Inquirer.js with per-prompt-type imports (select, checkbox, input, etc), zero React/rendering deps, native TypeScript types, and requires Node >=20.17/22.13/23.5. Actively maintained, largest ecosystem, standard choice for structured multi-step interactive CLIs.
